name: backend-devtools-desktop
description: IDE de escritorio para inspeccionar la cadena frontend-backend de proyectos locales.

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -n vite,app -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:renderer" "npm:dev:app"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/browser/network-capture/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/analysis/routes/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/analysis/sql-analyzer/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder --dir --win
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
